topline.text: Another quiet stretch nationally - no new DfE, Ofsted or safeguarding announcements since Tuesday's briefing.

Locally, Sheffield's finance and performance committee met Monday to decide on £602k of funding for SEND-places expansions at Firth Park and Parkwood academies - the decision still hadn't surfaced publicly as of this morning.
topline.action: Worth checking with the council or Lift Schools if either is a feeder or partner.

topline.text: Reminder: this is the last working week before Sheffield schools break for autumn half term on Monday (26-30 October).

diary.text: South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority Board meets.
NEU's formal strike ballot over pay, funding and workload closes.

items.lede: Firth Park and Parkwood expansion decision still unconfirmed.
items.body: Sheffield's finance and performance committee met Monday to decide on passing £602,000 of government funding to Lift Schools - part of a £701,312 scheme giving Firth Park Academy three SEND rooms and 30 extra Year 7 places (240 to 270) - alongside a smaller, temporary expansion at Parkwood Academy. Both respond to a projected Year 7 places shortfall in 2027/28-2028/29. Three days on, no outcome has been reported publicly.
items.action: Still worth a line to SLT if either school is a feeder or partner - we'll flag the outcome once it's confirmed.

box.label: Jargon-buster - ICR
box.intro: Ofsted announced a new complaints route for schools last week, worth knowing before it reaches your corridor.
box.text: The Independent Complaint Review (ICR) is a pilot covering schools inspected in 2026/27. Unlike the current ICASO process, which only checks whether Ofsted followed its own procedure, the ICR can also assess whether the complaint outcome itself - including a published grade - was fair, and can trigger a fresh inspection.
